name: omp-kimi-datasource
description: Kimi Code data-source plugin for oh-my-pi: stocks (Wind, S&P, SEC EDGAR), macro (World Bank, IMF, FRED, NBS), Chinese government data & standards, corporate, academic, legal, WHO/FAO/OECD, financial news (Xinhua, Caixin, CLS), sell-side research, chemistry/bioinformatics (ChEMBL, PubChem, BLAST, PDB, UniProt), and materials science (Materials Project, OQMD)
